args.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: single 74-by-100 target-resolution RPG dialogue portrait candidate, transparent cutout. Create one substantive new redraw of Emo (埃墨·衬), male lining artisan in his mid forties.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact identity reference ONLY. Images 2, 3, 4, 5 are approved small-pixel portrait STYLE and tight framing references, not faces to copy.
Identity: preserve image 1 warm medium-brown skin, narrow angular face, dark brown chunky curls, small unadorned beige linen cap, distinctive long nose, clean shaven chin and simple faded blue-gray work smock with very dark brown apron. Mature him to his explicitly specified mid-forties with modest angular under-eye planes and a distinct nasolabial plane. He is not a boy. Keep his slender face, no broad beard or unrelated scars.
Expression: alert, self-contained careful craftsman listening with quiet concentration. Brows mostly level and relaxed, small dark-brown eyes looking slightly to viewer left, mouth closed and level with a slight asymmetry. No distressed lifted inner brows or sad frown.
Style: Match the four approved portraits: strong hard-edged economical low-resolution square pixel clusters, large angular nose bridge and cheekbone light/shadow shapes, dark warm outline, readable mature facial structure, limited muted earthy palette. Treat every dark curl as one of only 5 to 7 broad masses, not threads. Flat hard-edged color planes, no airbrush, no dither, no soft digital painting, no skin speckles, no fine hair strands.
Framing is crucial: a BIG FACE close-up only. The whole cap, hair, both ear silhouettes and jaw fit inside the frame, with about 2 target pixels margin on top and sides. The face including forehead, cheek and chin occupies almost all image height and width. Chin at approximately 85 percent image height, a VERY SHORT neck, only a thin 10-percent-height strip of blue-gray collar and apron strap at bottom. Do not draw chest, torso or hands. Do not extend a tall neck. Keep head and face larger than image 1, and face structure comparable to reference portraits. Slight three-quarter turn toward viewer left. Use the tall 74:100 canvas ratio.
Eye whites must be very subdued gray-tan tiny accents, no bright white eyes or highlights. Flesh forms at most 4-5 clear steps. No text, no symbols, no borders, no vignette, no scenery, no backdrop. Genuine alpha transparency.
Constraints: one separate character portrait only; identity and individual expression remain distinct from the style references. Do not copy a style reference face. Do not imply acquittal, guilt, exposed private family information or display injuries. Large native-looking pixel blocks, no photorealism, no anime gloss.
